fixes: Windows on Arm (Snapdragon): the installer is back. 0.2.0 shipped without it because the FFmpeg build it bundles had been deleted from where it was downloaded; MediaForge now keeps its own copy.
notes: Nothing else changed: on macOS, Windows x64 and Linux, 0.2.1 is the same as 0.2.0.
This preview isn't code-signed yet, and it runs on the Free plan while licences are still off.

summary: A faster download engine, a built-in browser, and many more sites.
features: Built-in browser: browse a site inside MediaForge and press Download when the page has something to save. Sign in there; the session stays on your computer. Ads are blocked.
New download engine for direct files and streams: several connections per file, and pause and resume without starting over.
Lists read from the page you have open: TikTok, Facebook, Bilibili, X, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Suno and embedded Vimeo players.
The browser recognises more sites, including Bilibili.tv, Medal, Dailymotion, SnackVideo, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Kuaishou, SoundCloud, Twitch, Reddit and Rumble.
Drama and film sites: AKDrama, KissKH, AsiaDrama, DramaTip, OneKh, FilmKhHD, Khmer Avenue and meWATCH, with one row per episode.
fixes: Security updates for the TLS library (rustls).
notes: This preview isn't code-signed yet: macOS and Windows show a warning the first time you open it. The Download page explains how to continue.

Licences, checkout and automatic updates are still off. This release runs on the Free plan (up to 720p, one download at a time); taking a whole list at once is a paid-plan feature, so for now save list items one at a time.
Rumble checks for bots: open the video in the built-in browser first, then download.

summary: The first public preview of MediaForge: save, convert and organize media you're permitted to save, on your own computer.
features: Paste a link to see every available quality, audio track and subtitle, then download with live progress.
A real download queue: several at once, pause and resume, retry, and recovery after a restart.
Converter for MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV and FLAC, running on your computer with FFmpeg.
Library with tags, duplicate detection and saved views; History records every step of every download.
Browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox: send the page you're on to MediaForge in one click.
Your own signed-in sessions (cookies.txt), kept in your system's secure credential store.
English, Khmer, Simplified Chinese and French.
notes: This preview isn't code-signed yet: macOS and Windows show a warning the first time you open it. The Download page explains how to continue.
Licences, checkout and automatic updates switch on in a later release. The preview runs on the Free plan (up to 720p, one download at a time).
